name: fleet_haiku_quality_compounders
strategy: Quality dividend payers and defensive value names positioned for rising-rate environment; emphasis on durable cash flows and dividend growth with financial sector exposure for net interest margin capture.
reassessment_note: Previous dividend/value strategy entered 2026-09-08 underperformed significantly (down -1.40% vs SPY +4.03%). Sector ETF approach (XLE, XLF, VTV) proved too reactive to recent weakness. Fed rate hike on 2026-09-16 should benefit financial names, but broader thesis requires repositioning. Pivoting to individual quality dividend compounders (PG, KO, JNJ) with proven dividend growth records, selective financial exposure (JPM), and defensive positioning. Expected to better capture rising-rate environment while maintaining dividend income mandate. Increased cash buffer (22%) provides tactical flexibility as rate cycle matures.

positions.thesis: Procter & Gamble leads with 70-year dividend growth streak and 2.96% yield. Consumer staples provide defensive stability in rising-rate environment. Strong pricing power offsets inflation pressure. Quality balance sheet supports continued dividend growth.

Johnson & Johnson offers 2.17% yield with 64-year dividend growth track record. Diversified healthcare exposure less sensitive to rate cycles. Conservative 47% payout ratio provides cushion for dividend expansion. Defensive quality for uncertain rate environment.

Coca-Cola delivers 2.7% yield with 64 years of consecutive dividend growth. Consumer staples with pricing power in inflationary regime. Unanimous Buy rating from analysts. Stable cash flows support value positioning.

Walmart provides defensive value exposure with 0.81% yield and most sustainable payout ratio (36%) among peers. Positioned to capture consumers trading down in challenging environment. Essential retail exposure with dividend expansion potential as earnings grow.

JP Morgan will capture net interest margin expansion from Fed rate hike to 3.75%-4%. $4.9T balance sheet with $2.68T deposits provides rate-sensitive earnings leverage. 24 analyst Buy consensus with 10.81% price target upside. Direct play on rising-rate scenario.

Verizon provides high-yield dividend income from telecom infrastructure. Stable cash flows support dividend sustainability. Less rate-sensitive than growth stocks but can benefit from stronger economic growth. Diversification into communications.

Berkshire Hathaway offers quality conglomerate exposure with fortress balance sheet. Modest dividend plus capital appreciation potential. Diverse operating businesses benefit from various rate scenarios. Conservative positioning for uncertain environment.

PepsiCo provides consumer staples dividend growth with diversified beverage and snacks portfolio. Pricing power supports dividend sustainability and growth through inflation. Defensive characteristics in rising-rate environment.
